title: Crash when creating and editing CurveTextures
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: v4.7.stable.arch_linux, V4.6.3.stable.arch_linux

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 09 Jul 2026 19:55:55 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated Intel(R) Arc(tm) B580 Graphics (BMG G21) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.55 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When setting CurveTextures for GPUParticles3D, the editor freezes and crashes, dumping the following error in the console:

```
ERROR: Couldn't wait for Vulkan fence (VkResult error -4).
   at: fence_wait (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3050)
ERROR: Printing last known breadcrumbs in reverse order (last executed first).
Some of them might be inaccurate. Try running with --accurate-breadcrumbs for precise information.
   at: print_lost_device_info (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:7007)
ERROR: Searching last breadcrumb. We've sent up to ID: 7120
Unicode parsing error, some characters were replaced with � (U+FFFD): Invalid UTF-8 leading byte (80)
ERROR: Last breadcrumb ID found: 7120
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: BLIT_PASS
ERROR: Last known breadcrumb: UI_PASS
ERROR: VK_EXT_device_fault not available.
   at: on_device_lost (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:6925)
ERROR: Vulkan device was lost. This could be due to a driver issue, a hardware issue, or the driver resetting itself because it was unresponsive for too long (TDR).
   at: command_queue_execute_and_present (drivers/vulkan/rendering_device_driver_vulkan.cpp:3263)

================================================================
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 4
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.stable.arch_linux (5b4e0cb0fd279832bbdd69fed5354d4e5ad26f88)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
Load address: 558245b6a000
```

Some times, assigning the texture worked, but crashed when I tried changing the width of the curve.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a GPUParticles3D node, assign a process material and assign a CurveTexture on any relevant field.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30099616/test.zip)
